entries.title: Recent messages stay quiet until you read them
entries.body: On desktop, your newest message and your first mate’s reply are softer above the message box. Move the pointer over the messages or focus a reply to brighten them; the first mate’s mark stays cyan. The second-to-last round now starts its fifteen-second fade clock when it becomes second-to-last, even while your first mate works on the newest message.

picture.alt: The newest message and reply sit quietly above the desktop message box, with the first mate’s cyan mark beside the reply
